story: I am 16 and work at a dhaba in Indore. The owner hasn't paid me for two months, Rs 6,000 a month.

timeline.event: Owner did not pay wages for September 2026
timeline.user_words: The owner hasn't paid me for two months

timeline.event: Owner did not pay wages for October 2026
timeline.user_words: The owner hasn't paid me for two months

facts.user_goal: Get the unpaid wages of Rs 6,000 for the last two months

messages: Because you (or the person) may be under 18, please call the Child Helpline on 1098. They can help get unpaid wages and keep the child safe. Employing a child is itself illegal, so this needs a person, not an app.
अगर उम्र 18 साल से कम है, तो 1098 (चाइल्ड हेल्पलाइन) पर कॉल करें। वे बकाया पैसे और बच्चे की सुरक्षा - दोनों में मदद करेंगे।
